title: Best AI Bootcamps in Germany 2026: A Data-Backed Comparison Guide
summary: Compare seven AI training providers in Germany by curriculum, entry requirements, teaching language and Bildungsgutschein funding.
body_markdown:
The best AI training programme in Germany depends on your experience, what you want to do with AI and your funding options. This guide compares seven providers by curriculum, entry requirements, teaching language and Bildungsgutschein funding.


For professionals with coding experience, AI Engineering develops the skills to build and deploy AI applications. For people in marketing, consulting, product, operations or finance, Building with AI Agents focuses on turning business problems into working AI tools.


### Key takeaways


-


[Bitkom](https://www.bitkom.org/Presse/Presseinformation/IT-Fachkraeftemangel-in-den-letzten-drei-Jahren-halbiert) estimated 79,000 unfilled IT positions in Germany in September 2026, down from 109,000 in 2025. These figures cover IT occupations generally, rather than AI roles specifically.


-


A Bildungsgutschein can cover 100% of tuition when both the provider and the specific programme are approved and the Agentur für Arbeit approves your funding.


-


Turing College is AZAV-certified, Bildungsgutschein-fundable, backed by Y Combinator.


## What does an AI training programme involve?


An AI training programme teaches you to apply AI through projects. Entry requirements and content vary: some programmes build on programming experience, while others focus on using AI agents to create tools for business tasks. Compare what you’ll build, the study commitment and how you’ll receive feedback.


## What is happening in Germany's AI job market in 2026?


Germany still has a shortage of IT professionals, but the number of unfilled positions has fallen.[Bitkom estimated 79,000 unfilled IT positions in September 2026](https://www.bitkom.org/Presse/Presseinformation/IT-Fachkraeftemangel-in-den-letzten-drei-Jahren-halbiert) , compared with 109,000 in 2025.


In the same research, 49% of companies with IT positions expected AI use to increase demand for IT professionals with AI knowledge, while 48% expected no additional demand. These are employer expectations, rather than a count of current AI vacancies.


Bitkom’s findings draw on two representative surveys of 853 and 602 companies with at least three employees in Germany. The figures describe the wider IT labour market and do not establish how easily someone completing an AI programme will find work.


## How does Bildungsgutschein funding work?


A[Bildungsgutschein](https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/karriere-und-weiterbildung/bildungsgutschein) can cover the tuition fees for an approved AI training programme. Depending on your circumstances, funding may also cover travel, childcare and other eligible costs. The Agentur für Arbeit decides what is covered during your individual consultation. Your voucher specifies its validity period, regional restrictions and training objective.


Providers without AZAV certification cannot accept it, regardless of how good their curriculum is. AZAV requires an independent audit of educational quality, instructor qualifications, and learner outcomes. It is a real quality filter, not just a logo.


Prepare for your consultation with an approved programme, current job advertisements matching your target role, and an explanation of how the training builds on your experience.


## How we evaluated the programmes on this list


We evaluated each provider against four criteria we could verify from public sources: AZAV certification and Bildungsgutschein eligibility, Generative AI and LLM curriculum depth, MLOps and deployment content, and independent ratings on Course Report.


We only included what each provider states publicly on their programme pages. Where a tool, framework, or certification is not listed publicly, we note that directly rather than assume it does not exist. Confirm specifics with admissions before applying.


## The seven AI bootcamps in Germany worth comparing in 2026


*To verify current Bildungsgutschein eligibility for any provider, search their name at* *[mein-now.de](https://mein-now.de/)* *- Germany's official funded training database.*


### 1. Turing College: AI Engineering and Building with AI Agents


**Best for:** People who want to build AI applications using existing coding experience, or turn problems in their field into working AI tools, with individual project feedback.


**Founded / Scale:** Founded in 2020 in Lithuania, Turing College is a[Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/) -backed provider offering AZAV-certified programmes focused on practical, up-to-date AI training.


**Programmes** : AI Engineering and Building with AI Agents


**Teaching languages:** English.


**Rated:** Coursereport 5/5, Google 5/5


Programme comparison: Turing College AI Engineering Building with AI Agents


Who it is for People who want to use their Python or JavaScript experience to build AI applications. At least 1 year of coding experience required. Professionals who want to turn problems in their field into working AI tools. No previous coding experience required.


Funded study duration 3 months at 30 hours per week with Bildungsgutschein funding


Self-funded study duration 3 to 4 months at 10+ hours per week 3.5 to 4.5 months at 12 hours per week


What you build AI applications that use your own data, answer questions and carry out tasks, including a deployed capstone you can show employers. Tools that address a business problem, connect to data or automate recurring work, including an AI assistant and a project of your own design.


Key tools Python or JavaScript, LangChain, LangGraph, ChromaDB, Streamlit, Next.js and APIs from AI model providers Claude Code, Next.js, Supabase, Vercel and MCP


How you can use these skills Add AI application development to your current work, build your own product or pursue AI engineering roles. Build tools for work you understand in marketing, consulting, product, operations or finance, or develop your own business idea.


Career support For Bildungsgutschein-funded learners in both programmes: build your job search around your experience and new AI skills. The career module helps you identify suitable roles, prepare your CV and LinkedIn profile, and practise HR and technical interviews. Includes weekly live career Q&A and monthly career webinars.


Bildungsgutschein 100% of tuition covered with approved funding. The Agentur für Arbeit assesses eligibility individually and must approve funding before you start.


‍


**Graduate example:** Prachi Dipak Deshmukh used a Bildungsgutschein to fund her AI Engineering place and is now a Software QA Engineer at Tesla.


"I gained hands-on experience with the latest AI trends and technologies. The programme strengthened my practical skills and prepared me to apply AI in real-world situations."


### 2. neue fische - School of Data and AI


**Best for:** Learners who want structured cohort-based training with IHK certification available on selected programmes.


**Founded / Scale:** Founded in 2014. Merged with Spiced Academy in 2024. Multiple locations across Germany.


**Programmes:** Wide range of data, AI, and tech bootcamps from weeks to months, in-person and online across Germany


**Teaching languages:** English for the currently advertised Data Science and AI and Agentic AI programmes. Other programmes may differ.


**Rated:** Coursereport 3.9/5, Google 4.6/5


### 3. Le Wagon - Berlin and Online


**Best for:** Learners who want a globally recognised brand with a wide range of programmes across data, AI, and web development.


**Founded / Scale:** Founded in 2013 in Paris. 30,000+ alumni. 40+ campuses worldwide.


**Programmes:** Range of data, AI, and web development bootcamps, full-time and part-time, in-person in Berlin and online.


**Teaching languages:** English for the advertised Data Science and AI programme in Germany and online. Confirm the language of your chosen group.


**Rated:** Course Report 4.95/5


### 4. WBS Coding School - Online


**Best for:** Learners in Germany who want fully online, instructor-led training with optional German language integration via the SpeakTech programme.


**Founded / Scale:** Online-first school, part of WBS Training AG, established in 1980. 280+ locations across Germany for in-person study space.


**Programmes:** Range of AI, data, and web development bootcamps from 8 to 23 weeks, full-time and part-time.


**Teaching languages:** English or German, depending on the programme and group. Some programmes are offered only in English or only in German.


**Rated:** Course Report 4.8/5


### 5. Liora - formerly DataScientest - Germany and Online


**Best for:** Learners who want flexible online training across data, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity, with Sorbonne University certification on completion.


**Founded / Scale:** Founded in 2017 in Paris as DataScientest. Rebranded to Liora in 2025, merging DataScientest, CyberUniversity, and DevUniversity. 50,000+ alumni.


**Programmes:** A range of data, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity programmes, fully online. Visit liora.io for the full catalogue.


**Teaching languages:** English and German options are advertised, alongside French and Spanish. Confirm availability for your chosen programme and group.


**Rated:** Course Report 4.5/5 (listed as DataScientest)


### 6. Constructor Academy (Constructor Nexademy) - Germany and Switzerland


**Best for:** Learners who want modular options alongside a full data science programme, in-person or online.


**Founded / Scale:** A rebrand of Propulsion Academy, owned by Constructor Group. In-person in Munich, Bremen, and Frankfurt, plus fully online.


**Programmes:** A range of data science, generative AI, and Python programmes from 6 weeks to 22 weeks part-time.


**Teaching languages:** English for the advertised remote Data Science and AI Intensive programme. Confirm other programmes separately.


**Rated:** Course Report 4.9/5, Google 4.9/5


### 7. Ironhack - Berlin and Online


**Best for:** Learners who want scheduling flexibility across full-time and part-time formats, with career support up to one year post-graduation.


**Founded / Scale:** Founded in 2013. Global school with campuses in Berlin, Madrid, Barcelona, Paris, Amsterdam, Lisbon, and online. 20,000+ graduates.


**Programmes:** AI Engineering, Data Analytics, Web Development, UX/UI Design, Cybersecurity, and Data Science, full-time and part-time.


**Teaching languages:** English for the currently advertised online AI Engineering groups accessible from Germany. Confirm other programmes separately.


**Rated:** Course Report 4.7/5


## From training to job search: what to expect


Projects give you evidence of what you can do. Career preparation helps you connect that work and your previous experience to suitable roles, applications and interviews.


Bildungsgutschein-funded learners in Turing College’s AI Engineering and Building with AI Agents programmes receive a career module covering job-search planning, CV and LinkedIn preparation, and mock HR and technical interviews. Weekly live career Q&A and monthly career webinars give you opportunities to discuss your search and prepare for recruitment conversations.


## **What a strong AI curriculum covers in 2026**


The right curriculum depends on where you are starting from.


If you already write code, look for a programme that helps you build AI applications for your work, your own product or an AI engineering role. Turing College’s[AI Engineering](https://www.turingcollege.com/ai-engineering-bildungsgutschein) programme builds on your Python or JavaScript experience to help you develop, evaluate and deploy applications that use your own data and carry out tasks. You’ll work with prompt engineering, RAG, vector databases, LangChain and LangGraph, finishing with a deployed capstone you can demonstrate and explain at an interview. Explore examples in the[Project Showcase](https://showcase.turingcollege.com/) .


If your experience is in marketing, consulting, product, operations or finance, look for a programme that helps you turn a problem in your field into a working AI tool. Turing College’s[Building with AI Agents](https://www.turingcollege.com/building-with-ai-bildungsgutschein) teaches you to define what the tool should do, guide AI agents to build it, and test and improve the results. You’ll build tools connected to data, an AI assistant and a capstone project of your own design. No previous coding experience is required.


For either programme, look at what you’ll build and how your work will be reviewed. Projects should give you opportunities to test results, understand limitations and explain your decisions. At Turing College, mentors review your projects individually and give you feedback on what to improve.[Meet the education team and learn how project reviews work](https://www.turingcollege.com/de/bildungsteam) .


## Who qualifies for the Bildungsgutschein?


You may qualify for a Bildungsgutschein if training could help you find work or prevent unemployment. The Agentur für Arbeit assesses your circumstances and whether the chosen programme supports your employment goals during an individual consultation.


Both the provider and the specific programme must be approved for funding. Your voucher sets out its validity period, regional restrictions and training objective. Check these conditions before enrolling.


Turing College’s free two-minute[eligibility quiz](https://eligibility-quiz.turingcollege.com/) offers an initial check before your appointment. The Agentur für Arbeit makes the final funding decision.


For more detail in German, read our[guide to AI training with a Bildungsgutschein](https://www.turingcollege.com/de/blog/ki-weiterbildung-bildungsgutschein-guide) , covering who may qualify, which costs funding can cover and how to prepare for your consultation.


## What to do next


Three steps, in order:


1.


**Check your potential eligibility.** Take Turing College’s free two-minute[eligibility quiz](https://eligibility-quiz.turingcollege.com/) for an initial indication. The Agentur für Arbeit makes the final funding decision.


2.


**Choose a programme and apply.** Explore[AI Engineering](https://www.turingcollege.com/ai-engineering-bildungsgutschein) if you already have coding experience, or[Building with AI Agents](https://www.turingcollege.com/building-with-ai-bildungsgutschein) if you want to turn problems in your field into working AI tools. Our admissions team can help you assess the fit and provide an education offer for your funding consultation.


3.


**Prepare for your funding consultation.** Arrange an appointment with the Agentur für Arbeit or speak to your Jobcenter adviser. Bring your CV, programme information, education offer and current job advertisements showing demand for the skills you want to learn. Explain how the programme builds on your experience and supports your employment goals.


Check the validity period and conditions on your voucher. Submit it to Turing College and confirm your funded place before the programme starts.


## Frequently asked questions


Can you learn AI engineering in three months?


Yes, if you already have programming experience, a focused three-month programme can teach you to build, evaluate and deploy AI applications. Turing College’s AI Engineering programme requires at least one year of Python or JavaScript experience. You complete projects, including a deployed capstone, with individual technical feedback. Finding a role afterwards also depends on your previous experience and the positions you apply for.


Can you get an AI engineering job in Germany without a degree?


Yes. Employers in Germany advertise AI engineering roles that accept equivalent practical experience instead of a university degree. For example,[MeJuvante’s LLM / GenAI Engineer vacancy](https://mejuvante.ai/careers/llm-genai-engineer) accepts a computer science degree or equivalent practical experience and asks for a portfolio of deployed applications. Relevant work experience and projects you can demonstrate and explain can support this route. Requirements vary by employer.


What should you look for in an AI training programme?


Choose a programme that fits your starting experience and what you want to do with AI. Review the projects, entry requirements, study schedule, teaching language and feedback process. For a programme aimed at employment, also check the career support and how its curriculum relates to current vacancies. A certificate records completion; projects let you demonstrate what you can do.


Can a Bildungsgutschein cover AI training in Germany?


Yes. A Bildungsgutschein can cover approved AI training when both the provider and the specific programme are authorised for funding and the Agentur für Arbeit approves your place. Turing College offers funded places on AI Engineering and Building with AI Agents. Approval must be obtained before the programme starts. See the[official Bildungsgutschein guidance](https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/karriere-und-weiterbildung/bildungsgutschein) for the conditions.


Can you study AI online in English with a Bildungsgutschein?


Yes. Approved English-language online AI programmes can be funded through a Bildungsgutschein. Turing College offers English-language study in AI Engineering and Building with AI Agents. Confirm the language and schedule for your chosen start date before enrolling. Your funding consultation may take place in German.


Which AI programme can you take without coding experience?


Turing College’s Building with AI Agents requires no previous coding experience. It helps professionals in marketing, consulting, product, operations, finance and related fields turn business problems into working AI tools. You learn to define the task, guide AI agents, and test and improve the results. AI Engineering is for people with at least one year of Python or JavaScript experience.


What career support comes with Turing College’s funded AI programmes?


Bildungsgutschein-funded learners in AI Engineering and Building with AI Agents receive a career module to build their job search around their experience and new AI skills. It covers identifying suitable roles, preparing a CV and LinkedIn profile, and practising HR and technical interviews. Learners also get weekly live career Q&A and monthly career webinars.


What salary can you earn in an AI engineering role in Germany?


Salary depends on your role, experience, location and employer. As a reference,[Stepstone’s KI-Entwickler/in salary data](https://www.stepstone.de/gehalt/KI-Entwickler-in.html) reports a median gross annual salary of €56,300 in Germany, checked in October 2026. This describes the occupation across experience levels. It is not a starting salary or a measured outcome for graduates of an AI programme.


Is an AI training programme worth it if you already have professional experience?


It can be, when the programme adds capabilities relevant to your work or next role. Someone with programming experience might learn to develop AI applications; someone in operations might learn to build a tool for a recurring process. Compare what you will learn and build with your goals, and consider the study time, feedback and funding available.
